newsitem.title: UK: Argos defies FTSE gain amid cautious comment.
newsitem.headline: Argos defies FTSE gain amid cautious comment.

text.p: Shares in catalogue retailer Argos Plc were weak in a sharply rising UK equity market on Monday amid cautious press comment following Friday's disappointing trading statement, dealers said.
The stock was down 1/2p at 622-1/2 by 1311 GMT, even as the FTSE 100 index rose 44.2 points or 1.1 percent to 4,100.8.
Saturday's influential Financial Times Lex column said that even after Friday's 110p tumble, Argos was rated more highly than retail growth stocks such as Dixons Group Plc and Next Plc.
It said Argos shares were on a multiple of about 16 times expected earnings for 1997. "At such a rating, the shares are still not cheap," it said.
On Friday, Argos reported lower-than-expected second-half sales and said annual profits were unlikely to exceed low-end analyst expectations.
